answer.sql:
WITH line_totals AS (
  SELECT invoiceid, SUM(extendedprice - taxamount) AS revenue_before_tax
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines
  GROUP BY invoiceid
),
invoice_totals AS (
  SELECT i.invoiceid, i.invoicedate, lt.revenue_before_tax
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i
  JOIN line_totals lt ON lt.invoiceid = i.invoiceid
  WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01'
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN invoicedate >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND invoicedate < DATE '2015-01-01' THEN revenue_before_tax END) AS rev_2014,
    SUM(CASE WHEN invoicedate >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01' THEN revenue_before_tax END) AS rev_2015
  FROM invoice_totals
)
SELECT ROUND(((rev_2015 - rev_2014) / NULLIF(rev_2014, 0)) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM yearly
LIMIT 501
